description.text: Eight single attacks (0.78 each), grants [Haste], [Meikyo Shisui], [Attach Ice] and [Burst Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Burst Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands, ATK, DEF, MAG, RES, MND, ACC and EVA +20%, SPD +10%
